content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain why blood glucose levels must be controlled
Describe the roles of insulin and glucagon in blood glucose regulation
Explain the mechanism of negative feedback in glucose control
Describe the role of the liver in glucose metabolism
